capabilities: Extract X bookmarks from the bookmarks page via an embedded webview
Import selected bookmarks as Markdown notes with frontmatter, images and quoted tweets
Sync incrementally, stopping at already-imported bookmarks
Import the full body of native X articles into notes
Copy the focal tweet or article to the clipboard as Markdown
disambiguation: Not a sync for Obsidian's own Bookmarks feature; it imports bookmarks from X (Twitter) into notes.
extras: Desktop only (relies on Electron's <webview> tag); uses X's internal data API with a scraping fallback, so X.com changes may break it; video files are not downloaded and embedded images remain on X's CDN.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture X bookmarks as notes, and doing it manually or via the API requires copying content or managing OAuth tokens.

relations.evidence: Sync your X (Twitter) bookmarks directly into your Obsidian vault
clipboard-copy the focal tweet/article with replies stripped, powered by Defuddle

summary: Syncs X (Twitter) bookmarks into Markdown notes through an embedded webview, with selective, incremental import and no API key.
